name: WISE 0855−0714
spectral_reason: Luhman 2014 Tables 1–2: [4.5]=13.89 vs [3.6]=17.44, J>23; prioritize D6 then D5. IRAC magnitudes are not SPHEREx flux predictions.
limitations: Position is observed Spitzer astrometry at MJD 56677.3, not a fitted barycentric reference position. Annual parallax at the anchor epoch is retained as an unknown offset (up to 0.454 arcsec).
Old proper motion uncertainties accumulate to roughly 1–2 arcsec by 2026.
Unknown radial velocity is explicitly assumed zero.
Known stationary blends in discovery field; no identification from a bright pixel.
Paper J2000 axes treated as ICRS at the stated position uncertainty; not a precision astrometric frame transformation.
proper_motion_convention: pm_ra_cosdec = d(alpha)/dt * cos(delta); pm_dec = d(delta)/dt; mas/yr
position_frame: Paper J2000 astrometry aligned via 2MASS; treated as ICRS for approximate visualization

name: Epsilon Indi B (Ba/Bb)
spectral_reason: T-dwarf pair; D2 near-IR and D6 long-wave exploratory samples.
limitations: 2MASS unresolved photocenter propagated with Chen et al. 2022 Table 4 barycentric proper motion; not either component orbit.
Ba/Bb separation <1 arcsec; unresolved at native SPHEREx scale; orbital photocenter not modeled.
2MASS observed anchor retains annual parallax offset; RV unknown, zero assumed.
proper_motion_convention: pm_ra_cosdec = d(alpha)/dt * cos(delta); pm_dec = d(delta)/dt; mas/yr
